The Hanno Festival (Reiwa 8) will be held over two days: November 7–8, 2026 (Sat–Sun).

This festival blends traditional events—floats and portable shrines, music performances, and lion dances—with a citizen parade, food stalls, and various activities. Local residents and visitors gather to celebrate together.

Location: Around Hanno Station North Exit (including Odori Avenue, Ginza Avenue, Chuo Avenue, and nearby streets).

Rain or shine the event will proceed, but it may be cancelled in severe weather. Some program details may change on either day.

For more information, visit: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e4%bb%a4%e5%92%8c8%e5%b9%b4%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e3%81%be%e3%81%a4%e3%82%8a%e3%80%8011-7%e5%9c%9f%ef%bd%a58%e6%97%a5
